  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Order handling" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="assembler" name="Assembler AG">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>receive</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>invoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="First of each month">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition><bpmn:timeCycle>0 0 0 1 * ?</bpmn:timeCycle></bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="send" name="Send the order to the supplier" />

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
